# FloGuard

FloGuard, LLC is a local, family-run drainage contractor based in Port Orange, Florida. We specialize in custom-engineered French drain systems, sump pump installations, and comprehensive yard drainage solutions for homeowners across Central Florida.

## What We Do
- **Exterior French Drains**: Perimeter trench systems with perforated pipe, clean gravel, and filter fabric to intercept groundwater and surface runoff before it reaches foundations.
- **Interior Drains + Sump Pumps**: Sub-surface drains routed to sealed sump basins with automatic pumps for crawlspaces, flat lots, and high water table areas.
- **Yard Drainage & Grading**: Catch basins, channel drains, re-grading, and swales to eliminate standing water on patios, driveways, and lawns.
- **Pump Maintenance & Monitoring**: Seasonal inspections, testing, cleaning, and smart monitoring to keep systems storm-ready year-round.

## Why FloGuard
We design every system specifically for Florida conditions: high water tables (often 2-6 ft), flat terrain, intense summer storms, sandy soils, and hurricane-related power outages. All installs include proper filter fabric, check valves, battery backup options, and code-compliant safe discharge.

## Service Areas
Port Orange, Daytona Beach, Sanford, Orlando, New Smyrna Beach, Ormond Beach, DeLand, Deltona, and surrounding Central Florida communities including Edgewater, DeBary, Lake Mary, and Winter Park.
